title: 【RPG Design Guides】Support Skills ③ Types of Support Skills

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】補助技③ 補助技の種類
blocks.translation: 【RPG Design Guides】Support Skills ③ Types of Support Skills

blocks.source: ほぼ全ての補助技に共通して、同じ効果であっても『対象範囲』『持続時間』『消費MP』等の設定によって、特徴付けが可能である。また、ここで分類した複数の特性を併せ持つ補助技や回復等の効果を併せ持つ補助技も存在する。
blocks.translation: As a general rule for almost all support skills, even skills with the same effect can be given distinct characteristics through settings such as “target range,” “duration,” and “MP cost.” There are also support skills that combine several of the traits classified here, as well as support skills that combine effects such as healing.

blocks.source: 能力を上昇させる
blocks.translation: Increasing Abilities

blocks.source: 補助技としては、最も基本的。キャラクターの能力を強化するというもの。
blocks.translation: The most basic type of support skill: strengthening a character’s abilities.

blocks.source: 上昇させる能力は『攻撃力』『守備力』『魔力』『魔法防御』『素早さ』『最大HP』『最大MP』『命中率』『回避率』『会心率』といったように様々なものが存在する。ＳＲＰＧ的な戦闘システムならば『移動力』や『射程』等も対象となる。他にも、そのゲーム独自のパラメータが存在するならば、それも対象にできるかどうか考えてみよう。
blocks.translation: There are many abilities that can be increased, such as “Attack,” “Defense,” “Magic,” “Magic Defense,” “Agility,” “Max HP,” “Max MP,” “Hit Rate,” “Evasion Rate,” and “Critical Rate.” In a strategy RPG-style battle system, “Movement” and “Range” could also be affected. If your game has unique parameters, consider whether they can be included as well.

blocks.source: 重ねがけができるかどうかも、大きな分かれ目。何度も重ねがけできるような調整の場合、強くなりすぎて、ゲームバランスの調整が難しい。
blocks.translation: Whether effects can be stacked is also a major dividing point. If they can be stacked repeatedly, the character can become too powerful, making game balance difficult to adjust.

blocks.source: 効果量は「能力やダメージを元のＸＸ％上昇させる」といったものが多いが、それにこだわる必要は無い。例えば、魔法を掛けた側の魔力に比例する値だけ、攻撃力が上昇するといった仕様も可能だ。この仕様ならば、補助技の得意なキャラ／苦手なキャラを作り分けることもできる。
blocks.translation: The effect amount is often expressed as “increase an ability or damage by XX% of its original value,” but there is no need to limit yourself to that. For example, you could increase Attack by an amount proportional to the caster’s Magic. With this specification, you can distinguish between characters who are good or poor at using support skills.

blocks.source: 攻撃を防ぐ・反射する
blocks.translation: Blocking or Reflecting Attacks

blocks.source: 様々な効果が考えられるが、適当に有名ＲＰＧから例を挙げてみる。
blocks.translation: Various effects are possible, but let’s look at a few examples from well-known RPGs.

blocks.source: 物理攻撃を半減するプロテス。魔法攻撃を半減するシェル。魔法攻撃を反射するリフレク。息攻撃を半減するフバーハ。息攻撃を一度だけ反射するおいかぜ。特定の属性攻撃を無効化するバファイやレビテト、状態異常を防ぐベール……などなど。
blocks.translation: Protect, which halves physical damage. Shell, which halves magical damage. Reflect, which reflects magical attacks. Fubaha, which halves breath attacks. Oikaze, which reflects a breath attack once. Bafai and Levitate, which nullify attacks of certain elements. Veil, which prevents status ailments—and so on.

blocks.source: ちなみにフバーハとおいかぜはＤＱ、残りはＦＦから。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, Fubaha and Oikaze are from Dragon Quest, while the others are from Final Fantasy.

blocks.source: 特徴付ける点は主に、以下の２点。
blocks.translation: The main points that give them distinct characteristics are the following two.

blocks.source: どのような攻撃を防ぐか？ 物理・魔法の様に広い場面に及ぶものから、息攻撃・特定の属性しか防がないものまで。
blocks.translation: What kinds of attacks does it block? These can range from broad categories such as physical and magical attacks to skills that block only breath attacks or specific elements.

blocks.source: どれほどの度合まで防げるか？ ダメージを特定のポイントだけ減らす。半減する。無効化する。吸収する。あるいは反射するという様に分かれる。また、サガシリーズの防御術には確率によって、攻撃を無効化するものがある。
blocks.translation: To what extent can it protect against them? The effects can reduce damage by a set amount, halve it, nullify it, absorb it, or reflect it. In addition, some defensive techniques in the SaGa series have a chance to nullify attacks.

blocks.source: 物理や魔法を無効・反射する等の効果は非常に強力なので、もし作る場合はデメリットも付加しておきたい。
blocks.translation: Effects that nullify or reflect physical or magical attacks are extremely powerful, so if you create one, you should also give it some disadvantages.

blocks.source: 例としては……
blocks.translation: For example…

blocks.source: 攻撃魔法と同時に回復魔法まで反射してしまう。
blocks.translation: It also reflects healing spells along with offensive magic.

blocks.source: 自分に対するあらゆる攻撃を無効化するが、その間は動けない。
blocks.translation: It nullifies all attacks against the user, but the user cannot act during that time.

blocks.source: 味方全体に対するあらゆる攻撃を反射するが、多量のＭＰを消費する上に、１戦に１度しか使えない。
blocks.translation: It reflects all attacks against the entire party, but consumes a large amount of MP and can only be used once per battle.

blocks.source: 徐々にＨＰを回復
blocks.translation: Gradually Restoring HP

blocks.source: ＦＦシリーズのリジェネの様に、徐々にＨＰを回復する。地味ながら強力な回復系の補助技。ＨＰではなく、ＭＰ等を回復させる補助技を作ってもよいと思うが、例は知らない。
blocks.translation: Like Regen in the Final Fantasy series, this gradually restores HP. It is an inconspicuous but powerful healing support skill. You could also create a support skill that restores MP or something else instead of HP, but I do not know of any examples.

blocks.source: 効果時間が短く、効果量が低い -> 使う価値なし。
blocks.translation: Short duration and a weak effect -> Not worth using.

blocks.source: 効果時間が長く、効果量が高い -> ボス戦での定例作業。
blocks.translation: Long duration and a powerful effect -> Routine preparation for boss battles.

blocks.source: というように補助技としては、調整が難しい部類と言えるだろう。これに加えて、効果が遅効性であるためザコ戦では使いづらいという点でも難しい。
blocks.translation: As you can see, this is one of the more difficult types of support skills to balance. It is also difficult because its delayed effect makes it hard to use in battles against regular enemies.

blocks.source: ただ装備品や常時スキルの効果としてはバランスを崩しにくく安定するので、そちらでの使用を検討してみよう。
blocks.translation: However, as an effect of equipment or passive skills, it is stable and less likely to disrupt the balance, so consider using it that way.

blocks.source: どちらかというと回復技の範疇になる気もするが、とりあえずここに置いておく。
blocks.translation: It may be more appropriate to classify this as a healing skill, but I’ll leave it here for now.

blocks.source: 敵の標的を変化させる
blocks.translation: Changing the Enemy’s Target

blocks.source: 敵がどの味方キャラクターに対して、攻撃を仕掛けるかを操作する。古くはＤＱシリーズにあった「隊列の前にいるキャラクター程、狙われやすい」といった要素をプレイヤー側の技で操作しようというわけである。
blocks.translation: This lets you control which party member the enemy attacks. In older Dragon Quest games, elements such as “characters at the front of the formation are more likely to be targeted” existed; this allows the player to manipulate such factors through skills.

blocks.source: オンラインＲＰＧなどでは、敵毎に味方キャラクターへのヘイト（敵対心）が設定されている場合も多く、それに応じて狙われるキャラクターが変化する。ヘイトは戦闘中に取った行動によって、値が変化していく。オフラインのＲＰＧでも、ＦＦ１２やゼノブレイド等の作品でこの要素は重視されている。
blocks.translation: In online RPGs and similar games, each enemy often has a hate level (enmity) toward each party member, and the character targeted changes accordingly. Hate values change based on the actions taken during battle. Even in offline RPGs, this element is emphasized in games such as Final Fantasy XII and Xenoblade.

blocks.source: 標的の操作に関わる技は多数存在する。代表的なものをここでは挙げてみる。
blocks.translation: There are many skills involving target manipulation. Here are some representative examples.

blocks.source: かばう（ＦＦ）
blocks.translation: Cover (Final Fantasy)

blocks.source: 味方をかばって、敵の物理攻撃を次のターンまで引き受ける。ＦＦ１０では、味方全員をかばう様になった。上位バージョンの『鉄壁』では、防御とかばうを同時に行うので強力。全体攻撃や魔法攻撃には無効。
blocks.translation: The user protects an ally and takes enemy physical attacks in their place until the next turn. In Final Fantasy X, it was changed to protect all allies. The upgraded version, “Sentinel,” is powerful because it performs both Guard and Cover at the same time. It is ineffective against area attacks and magical attacks.

blocks.source: 仁王立ち（ＤＱ）
blocks.translation: Stand Firm (Dragon Quest)

blocks.source: かばうと類似だが、これはなんと味方全体への攻撃を何でもかばってしまう。下手をすると４人分への攻撃を食らって即死する。うまく使えば耐性のあるキャラクターで敵の攻撃を防ぎきるなんてことも。
blocks.translation: Similar to Cover, but this skill protects the entire party from every kind of attack. If used poorly, the user can take attacks meant for all four party members and die instantly. Used well, a character with suitable resistances can block all of the enemy’s attacks.

blocks.source: 挑発
blocks.translation: Provoke

blocks.source: 色んな作品に登場するが、大抵の場合、挑発を行う事で、敵の攻撃を自分に引き付けるという効果。状態異常として分類される場合もあるが、せっかくなのでこっちで扱う。何ターンかの間、効果が持続する場合が多い。
blocks.translation: This appears in many games, but in most cases, using Provoke draws enemy attacks toward the user. It is sometimes classified as a status ailment, but since it fits here, I’ll cover it in this section. Its effect often lasts for several turns.

blocks.source: デコイ（ＦＦ１２）
blocks.translation: Decoy (Final Fantasy XII)

blocks.source: 挑発に似ているが、自分では無く指定した味方キャラクターに攻撃を引き付ける魔法。
blocks.translation: Similar to Provoke, but this spell draws attacks toward a specified ally instead of the user.

blocks.source: 霧隠れ（ロマンシングサガ２）
blocks.translation: Veil of Mist (Romancing SaGa 2)

blocks.source: 指定した仲間の姿を霧で隠し、敵の攻撃対象から外す。全体への魔法攻撃には巻き込まれてしまう。また、隠れたキャラも攻撃を行うと解除されてしまう。
blocks.translation: It conceals a specified ally in mist, removing them from the enemy’s list of potential targets. They can still be caught in area-of-effect magic attacks. The effect is also dispelled if the hidden character attacks.

blocks.source: 特徴付ける点は……
blocks.translation: The points that give it distinct characteristics are…

blocks.source: 効果の持続時間
blocks.translation: Duration

blocks.source: 自分が対象なのか、特定の味方を選べるのか？
blocks.translation: Is the user the target, or can a specific ally be selected?

blocks.source: 物理攻撃だけか、魔法等にも効果があるのか？
blocks.translation: Does it affect only physical attacks, or does it also work against magic and other attacks?

blocks.source: 能力上昇の補助技の様に、使えば単純に楽になるといったものではないが、いずれも使用方法によって、戦闘が大きく楽になる傾向がある。プレイヤースキルが要求される補助技なので、戦闘の幅が広がる。
blocks.translation: Unlike ability-increasing support skills, these do not simply make things easier when used. However, depending on how they are used, they all tend to make battles much easier. Since these support skills require player skill, they expand the range of possible battle strategies.

blocks.source: 反撃技
blocks.translation: Counterattack Skills

blocks.source: 敵の攻撃を待ち構えて、反撃を行う。１ターンの間、攻撃を受ける度に、反撃し続けるというパターンが多い。反撃の内容は通常攻撃が多いが、それ以外の特殊効果も色々と考えられる。通常のダメージではなく「MPを奪う」「状態異常を与える」といったものでも面白いと思う。
blocks.translation: The user waits for an enemy attack and counterattacks. A common pattern is to counterattack every time the user is hit for one turn. The counterattack is usually a normal attack, but various other special effects are possible. Instead of dealing ordinary damage, effects such as “stealing MP” or “inflicting a status ailment” could also be interesting.

blocks.source: サガシリーズの『セルフバーニング』が有名。炎のバリアを張り、一度だけ、敵の近接攻撃に対して反撃しダメージを与える。ちなみに、セルフバーニングには炎系の攻撃を防ぐ複合効果もあったりする。
blocks.translation: Self-Burning from the SaGa series is well known. It creates a barrier of flames and counterattacks a single enemy close-range attack, dealing damage. Incidentally, Self-Burning also has the additional effect of blocking fire-based attacks.

blocks.source: 反撃する前に受ける攻撃はダメージを喰らう場合と無効化（稀に半減なども）できる場合に分かれる。受けたダメージをそのまま、あるいは倍増して跳ね返すような技も見られる。
blocks.translation: The attack received before the counterattack may either deal damage or be nullified (and, in rare cases, halved). There are also skills that return the damage received as-is or multiply it before reflecting it back.

blocks.source: 物理攻撃に対してのみ、反撃するというパターンが多い。それに限らず、魔法攻撃や特定の種類の攻撃に反応するといった設定も考えられる。
blocks.translation: Many skills counterattack only physical attacks. However, you could also design them to react to magical attacks or specific types of attacks.

blocks.source: 装備品や常時スキルの効果として、設定されていることが多い。ロマサガ３のアウナス等、敵に付けるのも嫌らしくて面白い。
blocks.translation: This is often set as an effect of equipment or passive skills. Giving it to enemies can also be nasty and interesting, such as Aunus in Romancing SaGa 3.

blocks.source: 行動順序（ターン）を操作する
blocks.translation: Manipulating the Action Order (Turns)

blocks.source: 素早さアップとは別の手段で、行動順序そのものを操作する。例えば、普段の順番を無視し、味方にターンを即座に回す。これによって、緊急時に回復役へターンを回して、回復を間に合わせたり、攻撃役に回して、怒涛の攻めをしたりといった戦術が可能となる。
blocks.translation: This manipulates the action order itself through means other than increasing agility. For example, it can ignore the usual order and immediately give an ally a turn. This enables tactics such as giving the healer a turn in an emergency so they can heal in time, or giving the attacker a turn to launch a furious assault.

blocks.source: 効果によっては、非常に強力なバランスブレイカーとなるので、制約も考えよう。
blocks.translation: Depending on the effect, this can be an extremely powerful balance breaker, so consider adding some limitations.

blocks.source: ディープキッス（タクティクスオウガ）
blocks.translation: Deep Kiss (Tactics Ogre)

blocks.source: 隣接した１キャラへターンを即座に回す。ＳＲＰＧは位置取りが重要なので、有利な場所にいるキャラに何度も行動を回すといった使い方ができる。使用者は能力が低めのフェアリー限定だが、何匹でも戦闘に投入可能である。
blocks.translation: Immediately gives a turn to one adjacent character. Since positioning is important in SRPGs, it can be used to give characters in advantageous positions multiple turns in succession. Only fairies, whose abilities are relatively low, can use it, but any number of them can be deployed in battle.

blocks.source: 踊る（ファイアーエムブレム）
blocks.translation: Dance (Fire Emblem)

blocks.source: 一度終了したキャラを再び行動させる。対象範囲は作品によって、隣接した１キャラだけだったり、隣接した４人を一気にだったりと異なる。強力な補助技だが、使用者は踊り子限定で、大抵は作品中に１人のみ。
blocks.translation: Allows a character who has already finished acting to act again. The target range varies by title: it may affect only one adjacent character, or four adjacent characters all at once. It is a powerful support skill, but only dancers can use it, and usually there is only one in the game.

blocks.source: クイックタイム（サガシリーズ）
blocks.translation: Quick Time (SaGa series)

blocks.source: ロマンシングサガ２にて登場。使用したターンは敵の行動を禁止する。
blocks.translation: First appeared in Romancing SaGa 2. It prevents enemies from acting during the turn in which it is used.

blocks.source: オーヴァードライブ（サガシリーズ）
blocks.translation: Overdrive (SaGa series)

blocks.source: 自分１人で何度も攻撃を繰り返し行う。非常に強力だが、サガフロンティアでは代償として全てのＪＰ（術ポイント）を消費する。
blocks.translation: The user repeatedly attacks several times on their own. It is extremely powerful, but in SaGa Frontier, it consumes all JP (Jutsu Points) as a price.

blocks.source: 敵の能力を調べる
blocks.translation: Investigating Enemy Abilities

blocks.source: ＦＦのライブラに代表される敵の能力を調べる技。
blocks.translation: A skill for investigating enemy abilities, exemplified by Libra from Final Fantasy.

blocks.source: これによって、敵の強さや弱点をプレイヤーに知らせることで戦略性を増す効果がある。
blocks.translation: By informing players of an enemy's strength and weaknesses, this increases the strategic element.

blocks.source: 親切設計で一度調べた敵、あるいは倒した敵の能力が簡単に見れるようになっている作品もある。また、最初から敵のＨＰが簡単に分かるようになっている作品もあるが、戦略性が増す反面、いつ敵を倒せるかというドキドキ感が減退する問題も。
blocks.translation: Some games are designed so that the abilities of enemies you have investigated or defeated can be viewed easily. Other games let you see enemy HP easily from the beginning, but while this increases the strategic element, it also reduces the suspense of wondering when you will be able to defeat an enemy.

blocks.source: 能力をコピーする
blocks.translation: Copying Abilities

blocks.source: ＤＱ３，４の『モシャス』。ファイアーエムブレムの『変身（チェイニー）』。ポケモンの『変身（メタモン）』など。他のキャラクターの姿や能力を完全あるいは部分的にコピーする。
blocks.translation: Examples include Mimic from Dragon Quest III and IV, Transformation (Chainey) from Fire Emblem, and Transform (Ditto) from Pokémon. These copy another character's appearance or abilities, either completely or partially.

blocks.source: 戦闘参加人数の多いＳＲＰＧならともかく、通常のＲＰＧでは、そのキャラクター本来の個性を失ってしまうということでもあるため、調整が難しい。やはり問題があったのか、ＤＱ５以降では、モシャスは敵専用技となった。
blocks.translation: Unlike in an SRPG with many participants in battle, in a regular RPG this can cause a character to lose their original individuality, making it difficult to balance. Perhaps because this was seen as a problem, from Dragon Quest V onward, Mimic became an enemy-only skill.

blocks.source: ＦＦの青魔道士の様に、敵の技をコピーして修得するのもこれに含めても良いかも。部分的なコピーという考え方では、有利なステータス変化をコピーするといった技もある。
blocks.translation: This might also include learning skills by copying enemy techniques, like the Blue Mage in Final Fantasy. With partial copying, there are also skills that copy beneficial status changes.

blocks.source: 変身
blocks.translation: Transformation

blocks.source: 上記の能力コピーとは別物。姿を変えると同時に、新しい能力を使えるようになったり、能力が上昇したりする。単なるモードチェンジ程度のものから、人間が魔物に変化する例も。変身後は行動を指定できなくなることも多い。
blocks.translation: This is different from the ability copying described above. Along with changing appearance, the character becomes able to use new abilities or has their abilities increased. Examples range from simple mode changes to humans transforming into monsters. After transforming, the character often can no longer be given specific commands.

blocks.source: 大抵はシナリオ上で変身できる理由が説明される。ブレスオブファイアやシャドウハーツといった作品では、物語上も大きな意味を占めている。
blocks.translation: The story usually explains why the character can transform. In titles such as Breath of Fire and Shadow Hearts, transformation also has major significance in the story.

blocks.source: ヴィンセントのリミット技（ＦＦ７）
blocks.translation: Vincent's Limit Technique (Final Fantasy VII)

blocks.source: 変身する魔物の種類を選択することができる。効果は戦闘終了か戦闘不能まで永続するが、操作ができないので使いづらいかも。
blocks.translation: You can choose which monster to transform into. The effect lasts until the battle ends or the character is incapacitated, but it may be difficult to use because you cannot control the character.

blocks.source: 竜変身（ブレスオブファイアシリーズ）
blocks.translation: Dragon Transformation (Breath of Fire series)

blocks.source: いずれも変身後も行動の指定が可能。
blocks.translation: In all cases, you can still choose the character's actions after transforming.

blocks.source: ３では竜型から人形まで形状は様々。強力な竜に変身するほど、毎ターンＭＰを多く消費するようになっており、ＭＰが切れれば変身が解除される。ちなみに、２のみ単なるMP消費の激しい攻撃魔法の扱いになっている。
blocks.translation: In Breath of Fire III, the forms vary from dragons to dolls. The more powerful the dragon transformed into, the more MP is consumed each turn; when MP runs out, the transformation ends. Incidentally, in II alone, it is treated as a regular attack spell with a particularly high MP cost.

blocks.source: シャドウハーツシリーズの変身もこれの３の仕様に良く似ている。
blocks.translation: Transformation in the Shadow Hearts series also closely resembles the system used in III.

blocks.source: ワータイガー（ブレスオブファイア３）
blocks.translation: Weretiger (Breath of Fire III)

blocks.source: レイの特技。虎の姿に変身し本能のまま攻撃する。攻撃力は異常に上がるが、行動が指定できなくなる上に、味方に攻撃し出すこともある。
blocks.translation: One of Rei's Techs. He transforms into a tiger and attacks on instinct. His attack power rises abnormally high, but you can no longer choose his actions, and he may even start attacking allies.

blocks.source: 『めいれい』の技を他の仲間に使用させれば、常に指定した敵に攻撃できるようになる。
blocks.translation: If you have another party member use the Command skill on him, he will always be able to attack the designated enemy.

blocks.source: 「変身できる条件」「変身後の能力」「維持できる時間・コスト」等で差別化が可能となる。
blocks.translation: It is possible to differentiate transformations through factors such as the conditions for transforming, abilities after transforming, and the duration or cost of maintaining the transformation.

blocks.source: 召喚
blocks.translation: Summoning

blocks.source: ここでいう召喚とは、ＦＦ３～９の召喚の様に単に１度だけ呼び出して効果を発揮するものではない。その場合は演出が派手なだけの通常技と大差ない。
blocks.translation: The summoning referred to here is not the kind that is simply called once to produce an effect, like summons in Final Fantasy III–IX. In that case, it is not much different from a regular skill with flashy presentation.

blocks.source: ＤＱ６のように新たな５人目の仲間として戦ったり、ＦＦ１０の様に味方全員の代わりに戦ったりするものを指す。
blocks.translation: This refers to summons that fight as a new fifth party member, as in Dragon Quest VI, or fight in place of the entire party, as in Final Fantasy X.

blocks.source: 大まかには以下の３種類に分かれる。
blocks.translation: Broadly speaking, they can be divided into the following three types.

blocks.source: 既存のパーティメンバーに加えて、追加の仲間として行動を行なってくれる。
blocks.translation: Acts as an additional companion alongside the existing party members.

blocks.source: 召喚を行った術者に代わって、召喚されたキャラが行動を行う。使用感は上の変身に近い。
blocks.translation: The summoned character acts in place of the summoner. It feels similar to the transformation described above.

blocks.source: 味方全員が行動できなくなる代わりに、召喚されたキャラが１体で行動を行う。
blocks.translation: The summoned character acts alone, while all allies become unable to act.

blocks.source: 戦闘不能時に自動的に蘇生を行う
blocks.translation: Automatically Reviving upon Incapacitation

blocks.source: ＨＰが０になった場合など、戦闘不能になった際に、自動的に蘇生を行う補助技。ＦＦ６から登場したリレイズやロマサガ２のリヴァイヴァが代表的。
blocks.translation: A support skill that automatically revives a character when they become incapacitated, such as when their HP reaches 0. Examples include Reraise, introduced in Final Fantasy VI, and Reviva from Romancing SaGa 2.

blocks.source: かなり強力な補助技であるため、緊張感がなくなるという問題も。ＦＦ１０では敵がどんなに強力な攻撃を仕掛けてきても、これ１つで完全防御できてしまうという状況があった。
blocks.translation: Since this is an extremely powerful support skill, it can also eliminate the sense of tension. In Final Fantasy X, there were situations where even the most powerful enemy attacks could be completely defended against with just this one effect.

blocks.source: これでまともにバランスを取ろうとすると「消費を非常に大きくする」「敵の攻撃を非常に激しくする」「敵に打ち消し技を使わせる」といった極端な調整になりやすい。
blocks.translation: Trying to balance this properly tends to lead to extreme adjustments, such as making the cost extremely high, making enemy attacks extremely fierce, or having enemies use dispelling skills.

blocks.source: 使うならば、「戦闘中一度だけ戦闘不能からＨＰ１で復活するアクセサリ」といった程度に留めておくのが無難か。これでも結構強力だけど。
blocks.translation: If you use it, it may be safest to limit it to something like an accessory that revives the wearer with 1 HP from incapacitation once per battle. Even that is quite powerful, though.

blocks.source: 仲間にＭＰ等を譲る
blocks.translation: Giving MP or Other Resources to Allies

blocks.source: 他の仲間にＭＰを譲る。ＭＰの他にも、作品独自のポイントだったりする場合もある。ＤＱ８の『マホアゲル』等。譲るだけで、全体として何かが増えるわけではない。ターン消費してまで、使う価値があるのかは怪しいことが多く、あまり活用されることは少ない。
blocks.translation: Gives MP to another ally. In some games, it may give a unique resource instead of MP. Examples include Mahō Ageru from Dragon Quest VIII. Since it only transfers resources, it does not increase the total amount available. It often seems questionable whether it is worth spending a turn on, so it is rarely put to much use.

blocks.source: ＭＰ回復がシビアな調整ならば、使用価値も出るか。他にも「魔力が低く、良い魔法も覚えないが、最大ＭＰは高い」みたいなキャラを作って、覚えさせれば良いかも。
blocks.translation: It might be worth using in a game where MP recovery is carefully restricted. Another possibility is to create a character with low magic power who does not learn useful spells but has high maximum MP, and teach them this skill.

blocks.source: なお、ＨＰを譲るのは普通に回復技を使った方が早いのであまり見られない。
blocks.translation: Giving away HP is rarely seen, since using a regular healing skill is faster.

blocks.source: 場の状態・属性を変化
blocks.translation: Changing the Field State or Attribute

blocks.source: その場所自体の状態や属性を変容させる補助技で、敵味方全体に作用する。特定の種類の技を強化・弱化・禁止するなど効果は様々。ゲームシステムにも大きく依存する。
blocks.translation: These are support techniques that transform the state or attributes of the location itself, affecting all allies and enemies. Their effects vary, such as strengthening, weakening, or prohibiting certain types of techniques. They also depend heavily on the game system.

blocks.source: フォースフィルド（ＦＦ６）
blocks.translation: Force Field (FF6)

blocks.source: ＦＦ６の青魔法で終盤のボスからラーニング可能。８種類ある属性攻撃のいずれかをランダムで無効化する。
blocks.translation: A Blue Magic spell in FF6 that can be learned from bosses late in the game. It randomly nullifies one of eight types of elemental attacks.

blocks.source: ８回使えば全ての属性が無効に。覚えられるのがラストダンジョンの途中な上、その頃には敵味方共に無属性魔法や物理攻撃が充実しているので微妙に影が薄い。発想としては面白いのだけどね……。
blocks.translation: After using it eight times, all elements are nullified. You can learn it partway through the final dungeon, but by then both enemies and allies have plenty of non-elemental magic and physical attacks, so it tends to be somewhat overlooked. The concept is interesting, though……

blocks.source: スコール（ロマサガ３）
blocks.translation: Squall (Romancing SaGa 3)

blocks.source: 敵全体にダメージを与えると共に、場の属性を水に必ず変化させる。場の属性（地相）というこのゲームならではのシステムに関連する術である。他の術でも確率で地相変化する。
blocks.translation: In addition to damaging all enemies, it always changes the field's element to water. It is a spell associated with this game's unique system of field elements, or geomancy. Other spells can also change the field element by chance.

blocks.source: ちなみに、地相が水（正確には玄武）だと「水術のダメージが２５％上昇」「水属性のキャラのＨＰが毎ターン回復」「特定の水術が効果を発揮」といった効果がある。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, when the field element is water (more precisely, Genbu), it has effects such as “water spell damage increases by 25%,” “the HP of water-element characters recovers each turn,” and “certain water spells take effect.”

blocks.source: デフゾショネル（タクティクスオウガ）
blocks.translation: Def Zonshoner (Tactics Ogre)

blocks.source: マップ全体に作用。炎の属性を持ったキャラクターの能力を強化し、水の属性を持ったキャラクターの能力を弱体化する。
blocks.translation: It affects the entire map. It strengthens the abilities of characters with the fire element and weakens the abilities of characters with the water element.

blocks.source: 重ねがけすると、かなりのバランスブレイカー。水・風・大地に対しても、同様の強化魔法が存在する。
blocks.translation: When stacked, it can seriously break the game's balance. Similar enhancement spells also exist for water, wind, and earth.

blocks.source: クアドコンバージ（ペルソナ４）
blocks.translation: Quad Convergence (Persona 4)

blocks.source: 後半のボス敵が使用する技。４属性ある内の１つの威力を強化し、他の３属性を弱化する。その後で、強化した属性の魔法を使用してくる。味方側でも逆手に取って、強化された属性魔法を使用し、敵に大ダメージを与えることも可能。
blocks.translation: A technique used by bosses in the latter half of the game. It strengthens the power of one of the four elements and weakens the other three. The boss then uses magic of the strengthened element. The party can also turn this to its advantage by using magic of the strengthened element to deal massive damage to the enemy.

blocks.source: 効果を持続させる
blocks.translation: Sustaining Effects

blocks.source: 補助技の効果が時間経過によって、切れる設定だった場合、それを持続させる技もまた補助技と成りうる。
blocks.translation: If the effects of a support technique are set to wear off over time, a technique that sustains those effects can also qualify as a support technique.

blocks.source: ただし、わざわざ時間経過で切れるようにバランス調整しているのに、さらにそれを補助技で持続させるなんて、ちょっとクドいのではないかという感は拭えないが……。
blocks.translation: However, even though the balance has been deliberately adjusted so that the effects wear off over time, having another support technique sustain them as well feels a bit excessive……

blocks.source: どちらかというと、補助技よりも常時スキルや装備品の付属効果にした方が良いかも。補助技をかけた時、あるいはかけられた時に、効果が普段よりも２ターン延長されるスキルとか。
blocks.translation: It might be better to make this a passive skill or an additional effect of equipment rather than a support technique. For example, a skill that extends the effect by two turns beyond normal whenever you use or receive a support technique.

blocks.source: 例は少ないが、ワイルドアームズ３の『パーマネンス』等がある。
blocks.translation: There are few examples, but Permanence from Wild Arms 3 is one.

blocks.source: 複合型
blocks.translation: Combined Types

blocks.source: 補助効果と別の補助効果。あるいは、攻撃や回復などの効果を併せて持たせることで別の補助技を作り出すことも可能である。
blocks.translation: It is also possible to create another support technique by combining one support effect with another, or by adding effects such as damage or healing.

blocks.source: シャドウサーバント（サガシリーズ）
blocks.translation: Shadow Servant (SaGa series)

blocks.source: 「ダメージを２倍にする」という能力上昇型の補助効果と「敵の物理攻撃を一度だけ無効化する」という防御型の補助効果の複合。
blocks.translation: A combination of the ability-enhancing support effect “doubles damage” and the defensive support effect “nullifies one of the enemy's physical attacks.”

blocks.source: 光の壁（ロマサガ２）
blocks.translation: Light Wall (Romancing SaGa 2)

blocks.source: 「そのターンの間、味方全体に対して、ダメージを半減する」という防御型の補助効果と「ターン終了時に敵にダメージを与える」という攻撃効果の複合。
blocks.translation: A combination of the defensive support effect “halves damage dealt to all allies for that turn” and the offensive effect “deals damage to enemies at the end of the turn.”

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Conclusion

blocks.source: 当記事で、ＲＰＧで使用される主な補助技をまとめることができたと思う。もちろん、これ以外の補助技のアイデアがあるならば、作成に挑戦してみて欲しい。
blocks.translation: I believe this article has covered the main support techniques used in RPGs. Of course, if you have ideas for other support techniques, I encourage you to try creating them.

blocks.source: 今回は味方側の視点を中心に解説したが、敵側について考えてみるのも面白い。味方が使えたならば、確実にバランスブレイカーとなるような補助技でも、敵専用技ならばそこまでには至らないということもある。そういう意味では、敵側の方が補助技の自由度は高いともいえる。
blocks.translation: This time, I mainly explained things from the allies' perspective, but it can also be interesting to consider the enemy's side. A support technique that would definitely break the balance if allies could use it may not be nearly as problematic when it is exclusive to enemies. In that sense, enemies can be said to have greater freedom when it comes to support techniques.

blocks.source: 補助技はゲームシステムとも密接に関連する。例えば、ＳＲＰＧにおける移動力アップの補助技などがその一例。自分独自のシステムを考えたならば、それに関連する補助技も考えてみよう。
blocks.translation: Support techniques are also closely connected to the game system. One example is a support technique that increases movement range in an SRPG. If you come up with your own unique system, try thinking of support techniques related to it as well.

lines.source: 既存のＲＰＧに登場する補助技の効果をまとめて分類してみる。[[LINK_1]]前回[[/LINK_1]]、挙げた対策に従って、有効活用するための案も多少考えてみた。

parts.source: 既存のＲＰＧに登場する補助技の効果をまとめて分類してみる。
、挙げた対策に従って、有効活用するための案も多少考えてみた。

lines.translation: I will summarize and categorize the effects of support skills appearing in existing RPGs. In the [[LINK_1]]previous article[[/LINK_1]], I also considered some ideas for making effective use of them based on the countermeasures I listed.
[[LINK_1]]> Return to the RPG Design Guides table of contents[[/LINK_1]]

texts.ほぼ全ての補助技に共通して、同じ効果であっても『対象範囲』『持続時間』『消費MP: As a general rule for almost all support skills, even skills with the same effect can be given distinct characteristics through settings such as “target range,” “duration,” and “MP cost.” There are also support skills that combine several of the traits classified here, as well as support skills that combine effects such as healing.
texts.補助技としては、最も基本的。キャラクターの能力を強化するというもの。: The most basic type of support skill: strengthening a character’s abilities.
texts.上昇させる能力は『攻撃力』『守備力』『魔力』『魔法防御』『素早さ』『最大HP』『: There are many abilities that can be increased, such as “Attack,” “Defense,” “Magic,” “Magic Defense,” “Agility,” “Max HP,” “Max MP,” “Hit Rate,” “Evasion Rate,” and “Critical Rate.” In a strategy RPG-style battle system, “Movement” and “Range” could also be affected. If your game has unique parameters, consider whether they can be included as well.
texts.重ねがけができるかどうかも、大きな分かれ目。何度も重ねがけできるような調整の場合: Whether effects can be stacked is also a major dividing point. If they can be stacked repeatedly, the character can become too powerful, making game balance difficult to adjust.
texts.効果量は「能力やダメージを元のＸＸ％上昇させる」といったものが多いが、それにこだ: The effect amount is often expressed as “increase an ability or damage by XX% of its original value,” but there is no need to limit yourself to that. For example, you could increase Attack by an amount proportional to the caster’s Magic. With this specification, you can distinguish between characters who are good or poor at using support skills.
texts.様々な効果が考えられるが、適当に有名ＲＰＧから例を挙げてみる。: Various effects are possible, but let’s look at a few examples from well-known RPGs.
texts.物理攻撃を半減するプロテス。魔法攻撃を半減するシェル。魔法攻撃を反射するリフレク: Protect, which halves physical damage. Shell, which halves magical damage. Reflect, which reflects magical attacks. Fubaha, which halves breath attacks. Oikaze, which reflects a breath attack once. Bafai and Levitate, which nullify attacks of certain elements. Veil, which prevents status ailments—and so on.
texts.ちなみにフバーハとおいかぜはＤＱ、残りはＦＦから。: Incidentally, Fubaha and Oikaze are from Dragon Quest, while the others are from Final Fantasy.
texts.特徴付ける点は主に、以下の２点。: The main points that give them distinct characteristics are the following two.
texts.どのような攻撃を防ぐか？ 物理・魔法の様に広い場面に及ぶものから、息攻撃・特定の: What kinds of attacks does it block? These can range from broad categories such as physical and magical attacks to skills that block only breath attacks or specific elements.
texts.どれほどの度合まで防げるか？ ダメージを特定のポイントだけ減らす。半減する。無効: To what extent can it protect against them? The effects can reduce damage by a set amount, halve it, nullify it, absorb it, or reflect it. In addition, some defensive techniques in the SaGa series have a chance to nullify attacks.
texts.物理や魔法を無効・反射する等の効果は非常に強力なので、もし作る場合はデメリットも: Effects that nullify or reflect physical or magical attacks are extremely powerful, so if you create one, you should also give it some disadvantages.
texts.攻撃魔法と同時に回復魔法まで反射してしまう。: It also reflects healing spells along with offensive magic.
texts.自分に対するあらゆる攻撃を無効化するが、その間は動けない。: It nullifies all attacks against the user, but the user cannot act during that time.
texts.味方全体に対するあらゆる攻撃を反射するが、多量のＭＰを消費する上に、１戦に１度し: It reflects all attacks against the entire party, but consumes a large amount of MP and can only be used once per battle.
texts.ＦＦシリーズのリジェネの様に、徐々にＨＰを回復する。地味ながら強力な回復系の補助: Like Regen in the Final Fantasy series, this gradually restores HP. It is an inconspicuous but powerful healing support skill. You could also create a support skill that restores MP or something else instead of HP, but I do not know of any examples.
texts.効果時間が短く、効果量が低い -> 使う価値なし。: Short duration and a weak effect -> Not worth using.
texts.効果時間が長く、効果量が高い -> ボス戦での定例作業。: Long duration and a powerful effect -> Routine preparation for boss battles.
texts.というように補助技としては、調整が難しい部類と言えるだろう。これに加えて、効果が: As you can see, this is one of the more difficult types of support skills to balance. It is also difficult because its delayed effect makes it hard to use in battles against regular enemies.
texts.ただ装備品や常時スキルの効果としてはバランスを崩しにくく安定するので、そちらでの: However, as an effect of equipment or passive skills, it is stable and less likely to disrupt the balance, so consider using it that way.
texts.どちらかというと回復技の範疇になる気もするが、とりあえずここに置いておく。: It may be more appropriate to classify this as a healing skill, but I’ll leave it here for now.
texts.敵がどの味方キャラクターに対して、攻撃を仕掛けるかを操作する。古くはＤＱシリーズ: This lets you control which party member the enemy attacks. In older Dragon Quest games, elements such as “characters at the front of the formation are more likely to be targeted” existed; this allows the player to manipulate such factors through skills.
texts.オンラインＲＰＧなどでは、敵毎に味方キャラクターへのヘイト（敵対心）が設定されて: In online RPGs and similar games, each enemy often has a hate level (enmity) toward each party member, and the character targeted changes accordingly. Hate values change based on the actions taken during battle. Even in offline RPGs, this element is emphasized in games such as Final Fantasy XII and Xenoblade.
texts.標的の操作に関わる技は多数存在する。代表的なものをここでは挙げてみる。: There are many skills involving target manipulation. Here are some representative examples.
texts.味方をかばって、敵の物理攻撃を次のターンまで引き受ける。ＦＦ１０では、味方全員を: The user protects an ally and takes enemy physical attacks in their place until the next turn. In Final Fantasy X, it was changed to protect all allies. The upgraded version, “Sentinel,” is powerful because it performs both Guard and Cover at the same time. It is ineffective against area attacks and magical attacks.
texts.かばうと類似だが、これはなんと味方全体への攻撃を何でもかばってしまう。下手をする: Similar to Cover, but this skill protects the entire party from every kind of attack. If used poorly, the user can take attacks meant for all four party members and die instantly. Used well, a character with suitable resistances can block all of the enemy’s attacks.
texts.色んな作品に登場するが、大抵の場合、挑発を行う事で、敵の攻撃を自分に引き付けると: This appears in many games, but in most cases, using Provoke draws enemy attacks toward the user. It is sometimes classified as a status ailment, but since it fits here, I’ll cover it in this section. Its effect often lasts for several turns.
texts.挑発に似ているが、自分では無く指定した味方キャラクターに攻撃を引き付ける魔法。: Similar to Provoke, but this spell draws attacks toward a specified ally instead of the user.
texts.指定した仲間の姿を霧で隠し、敵の攻撃対象から外す。全体への魔法攻撃には巻き込まれ: It conceals a specified ally in mist, removing them from the enemy’s list of potential targets. They can still be caught in area-of-effect magic attacks. The effect is also dispelled if the hidden character attacks.
texts.特徴付ける点は……: The points that give it distinct characteristics are…
texts.自分が対象なのか、特定の味方を選べるのか？: Is the user the target, or can a specific ally be selected?
texts.物理攻撃だけか、魔法等にも効果があるのか？: Does it affect only physical attacks, or does it also work against magic and other attacks?
texts.能力上昇の補助技の様に、使えば単純に楽になるといったものではないが、いずれも使用: Unlike ability-increasing support skills, these do not simply make things easier when used. However, depending on how they are used, they all tend to make battles much easier. Since these support skills require player skill, they expand the range of possible battle strategies.
texts.敵の攻撃を待ち構えて、反撃を行う。１ターンの間、攻撃を受ける度に、反撃し続けると: The user waits for an enemy attack and counterattacks. A common pattern is to counterattack every time the user is hit for one turn. The counterattack is usually a normal attack, but various other special effects are possible. Instead of dealing ordinary damage, effects such as “stealing MP” or “inflicting a status ailment” could also be interesting.
texts.サガシリーズの『セルフバーニング』が有名。炎のバリアを張り、一度だけ、敵の近接攻: Self-Burning from the SaGa series is well known. It creates a barrier of flames and counterattacks a single enemy close-range attack, dealing damage. Incidentally, Self-Burning also has the additional effect of blocking fire-based attacks.
texts.反撃する前に受ける攻撃はダメージを喰らう場合と無効化（稀に半減なども）できる場合: The attack received before the counterattack may either deal damage or be nullified (and, in rare cases, halved). There are also skills that return the damage received as-is or multiply it before reflecting it back.
texts.物理攻撃に対してのみ、反撃するというパターンが多い。それに限らず、魔法攻撃や特定: Many skills counterattack only physical attacks. However, you could also design them to react to magical attacks or specific types of attacks.
texts.装備品や常時スキルの効果として、設定されていることが多い。ロマサガ３のアウナス等: This is often set as an effect of equipment or passive skills. Giving it to enemies can also be nasty and interesting, such as Aunus in Romancing SaGa 3.
texts.素早さアップとは別の手段で、行動順序そのものを操作する。例えば、普段の順番を無視: This manipulates the action order itself through means other than increasing agility. For example, it can ignore the usual order and immediately give an ally a turn. This enables tactics such as giving the healer a turn in an emergency so they can heal in time, or giving the attacker a turn to launch a furious assault.
texts.効果によっては、非常に強力なバランスブレイカーとなるので、制約も考えよう。: Depending on the effect, this can be an extremely powerful balance breaker, so consider adding some limitations.
texts.隣接した１キャラへターンを即座に回す。ＳＲＰＧは位置取りが重要なので、有利な場所: Immediately gives a turn to one adjacent character. Since positioning is important in SRPGs, it can be used to give characters in advantageous positions multiple turns in succession. Only fairies, whose abilities are relatively low, can use it, but any number of them can be deployed in battle.
texts.一度終了したキャラを再び行動させる。対象範囲は作品によって、隣接した１キャラだけ: Allows a character who has already finished acting to act again. The target range varies by title: it may affect only one adjacent character, or four adjacent characters all at once. It is a powerful support skill, but only dancers can use it, and usually there is only one in the game.
texts.ロマンシングサガ２にて登場。使用したターンは敵の行動を禁止する。: First appeared in Romancing SaGa 2. It prevents enemies from acting during the turn in which it is used.
texts.自分１人で何度も攻撃を繰り返し行う。非常に強力だが、サガフロンティアでは代償とし: The user repeatedly attacks several times on their own. It is extremely powerful, but in SaGa Frontier, it consumes all JP (Jutsu Points) as a price.
texts.ＦＦのライブラに代表される敵の能力を調べる技。: A skill for investigating enemy abilities, exemplified by Libra from Final Fantasy.
texts.これによって、敵の強さや弱点をプレイヤーに知らせることで戦略性を増す効果がある。: By informing players of an enemy's strength and weaknesses, this increases the strategic element.
texts.親切設計で一度調べた敵、あるいは倒した敵の能力が簡単に見れるようになっている作品: Some games are designed so that the abilities of enemies you have investigated or defeated can be viewed easily. Other games let you see enemy HP easily from the beginning, but while this increases the strategic element, it also reduces the suspense of wondering when you will be able to defeat an enemy.
texts.ＤＱ３，４の『モシャス』。ファイアーエムブレムの『変身（チェイニー）』。ポケモン: Examples include Mimic from Dragon Quest III and IV, Transformation (Chainey) from Fire Emblem, and Transform (Ditto) from Pokémon. These copy another character's appearance or abilities, either completely or partially.
texts.戦闘参加人数の多いＳＲＰＧならともかく、通常のＲＰＧでは、そのキャラクター本来の: Unlike in an SRPG with many participants in battle, in a regular RPG this can cause a character to lose their original individuality, making it difficult to balance. Perhaps because this was seen as a problem, from Dragon Quest V onward, Mimic became an enemy-only skill.
texts.ＦＦの青魔道士の様に、敵の技をコピーして修得するのもこれに含めても良いかも。部分: This might also include learning skills by copying enemy techniques, like the Blue Mage in Final Fantasy. With partial copying, there are also skills that copy beneficial status changes.
texts.上記の能力コピーとは別物。姿を変えると同時に、新しい能力を使えるようになったり、: This is different from the ability copying described above. Along with changing appearance, the character becomes able to use new abilities or has their abilities increased. Examples range from simple mode changes to humans transforming into monsters. After transforming, the character often can no longer be given specific commands.
texts.大抵はシナリオ上で変身できる理由が説明される。ブレスオブファイアやシャドウハーツ: The story usually explains why the character can transform. In titles such as Breath of Fire and Shadow Hearts, transformation also has major significance in the story.
texts.変身する魔物の種類を選択することができる。効果は戦闘終了か戦闘不能まで永続するが: You can choose which monster to transform into. The effect lasts until the battle ends or the character is incapacitated, but it may be difficult to use because you cannot control the character.
texts.いずれも変身後も行動の指定が可能。: In all cases, you can still choose the character's actions after transforming.
texts.３では竜型から人形まで形状は様々。強力な竜に変身するほど、毎ターンＭＰを多く消費: In Breath of Fire III, the forms vary from dragons to dolls. The more powerful the dragon transformed into, the more MP is consumed each turn; when MP runs out, the transformation ends. Incidentally, in II alone, it is treated as a regular attack spell with a particularly high MP cost.
texts.シャドウハーツシリーズの変身もこれの３の仕様に良く似ている。: Transformation in the Shadow Hearts series also closely resembles the system used in III.
texts.レイの特技。虎の姿に変身し本能のまま攻撃する。攻撃力は異常に上がるが、行動が指定: One of Rei's Techs. He transforms into a tiger and attacks on instinct. His attack power rises abnormally high, but you can no longer choose his actions, and he may even start attacking allies.
texts.『めいれい』の技を他の仲間に使用させれば、常に指定した敵に攻撃できるようになる。: If you have another party member use the Command skill on him, he will always be able to attack the designated enemy.
texts.「変身できる条件」「変身後の能力」「維持できる時間・コスト」等で差別化が可能とな: It is possible to differentiate transformations through factors such as the conditions for transforming, abilities after transforming, and the duration or cost of maintaining the transformation.
texts.ここでいう召喚とは、ＦＦ３～９の召喚の様に単に１度だけ呼び出して効果を発揮するも: The summoning referred to here is not the kind that is simply called once to produce an effect, like summons in Final Fantasy III–IX. In that case, it is not much different from a regular skill with flashy presentation.
texts.ＤＱ６のように新たな５人目の仲間として戦ったり、ＦＦ１０の様に味方全員の代わりに: This refers to summons that fight as a new fifth party member, as in Dragon Quest VI, or fight in place of the entire party, as in Final Fantasy X.
texts.大まかには以下の３種類に分かれる。: Broadly speaking, they can be divided into the following three types.
texts.既存のパーティメンバーに加えて、追加の仲間として行動を行なってくれる。: Acts as an additional companion alongside the existing party members.
texts.召喚を行った術者に代わって、召喚されたキャラが行動を行う。使用感は上の変身に近い: The summoned character acts in place of the summoner. It feels similar to the transformation described above.
texts.味方全員が行動できなくなる代わりに、召喚されたキャラが１体で行動を行う。: The summoned character acts alone, while all allies become unable to act.
texts.ＨＰが０になった場合など、戦闘不能になった際に、自動的に蘇生を行う補助技。ＦＦ６: A support skill that automatically revives a character when they become incapacitated, such as when their HP reaches 0. Examples include Reraise, introduced in Final Fantasy VI, and Reviva from Romancing SaGa 2.
texts.かなり強力な補助技であるため、緊張感がなくなるという問題も。ＦＦ１０では敵がどん: Since this is an extremely powerful support skill, it can also eliminate the sense of tension. In Final Fantasy X, there were situations where even the most powerful enemy attacks could be completely defended against with just this one effect.
texts.これでまともにバランスを取ろうとすると「消費を非常に大きくする」「敵の攻撃を非常: Trying to balance this properly tends to lead to extreme adjustments, such as making the cost extremely high, making enemy attacks extremely fierce, or having enemies use dispelling skills.
texts.使うならば、「戦闘中一度だけ戦闘不能からＨＰ１で復活するアクセサリ」といった程度: If you use it, it may be safest to limit it to something like an accessory that revives the wearer with 1 HP from incapacitation once per battle. Even that is quite powerful, though.
texts.仲間にＭＰ等を譲る: Giving MP or Other Resources to Allies
texts.他の仲間にＭＰを譲る。ＭＰの他にも、作品独自のポイントだったりする場合もある。Ｄ: Gives MP to another ally. In some games, it may give a unique resource instead of MP. Examples include Mahō Ageru from Dragon Quest VIII. Since it only transfers resources, it does not increase the total amount available. It often seems questionable whether it is worth spending a turn on, so it is rarely put to much use.
texts.ＭＰ回復がシビアな調整ならば、使用価値も出るか。他にも「魔力が低く、良い魔法も覚: It might be worth using in a game where MP recovery is carefully restricted. Another possibility is to create a character with low magic power who does not learn useful spells but has high maximum MP, and teach them this skill.
texts.なお、ＨＰを譲るのは普通に回復技を使った方が早いのであまり見られない。: Giving away HP is rarely seen, since using a regular healing skill is faster.
texts.場の状態・属性を変化: Changing the Field State or Attribute
texts.その場所自体の状態や属性を変容させる補助技で、敵味方全体に作用する。特定の種類の: These are support techniques that transform the state or attributes of the location itself, affecting all allies and enemies. Their effects vary, such as strengthening, weakening, or prohibiting certain types of techniques. They also depend heavily on the game system.
texts.ＦＦ６の青魔法で終盤のボスからラーニング可能。８種類ある属性攻撃のいずれかをラン: A Blue Magic spell in FF6 that can be learned from bosses late in the game. It randomly nullifies one of eight types of elemental attacks.
texts.８回使えば全ての属性が無効に。覚えられるのがラストダンジョンの途中な上、その頃に: After using it eight times, all elements are nullified. You can learn it partway through the final dungeon, but by then both enemies and allies have plenty of non-elemental magic and physical attacks, so it tends to be somewhat overlooked. The concept is interesting, though……
texts.敵全体にダメージを与えると共に、場の属性を水に必ず変化させる。場の属性（地相）と: In addition to damaging all enemies, it always changes the field's element to water. It is a spell associated with this game's unique system of field elements, or geomancy. Other spells can also change the field element by chance.
texts.ちなみに、地相が水（正確には玄武）だと「水術のダメージが２５％上昇」「水属性のキ: Incidentally, when the field element is water (more precisely, Genbu), it has effects such as “water spell damage increases by 25%,” “the HP of water-element characters recovers each turn,” and “certain water spells take effect.”
texts.マップ全体に作用。炎の属性を持ったキャラクターの能力を強化し、水の属性を持ったキ: It affects the entire map. It strengthens the abilities of characters with the fire element and weakens the abilities of characters with the water element.
texts.重ねがけすると、かなりのバランスブレイカー。水・風・大地に対しても、同様の強化魔: When stacked, it can seriously break the game's balance. Similar enhancement spells also exist for water, wind, and earth.
texts.後半のボス敵が使用する技。４属性ある内の１つの威力を強化し、他の３属性を弱化する: A technique used by bosses in the latter half of the game. It strengthens the power of one of the four elements and weakens the other three. The boss then uses magic of the strengthened element. The party can also turn this to its advantage by using magic of the strengthened element to deal massive damage to the enemy.
texts.補助技の効果が時間経過によって、切れる設定だった場合、それを持続させる技もまた補: If the effects of a support technique are set to wear off over time, a technique that sustains those effects can also qualify as a support technique.
texts.ただし、わざわざ時間経過で切れるようにバランス調整しているのに、さらにそれを補助: However, even though the balance has been deliberately adjusted so that the effects wear off over time, having another support technique sustain them as well feels a bit excessive……
texts.どちらかというと、補助技よりも常時スキルや装備品の付属効果にした方が良いかも。補: It might be better to make this a passive skill or an additional effect of equipment rather than a support technique. For example, a skill that extends the effect by two turns beyond normal whenever you use or receive a support technique.
texts.例は少ないが、ワイルドアームズ３の『パーマネンス』等がある。: There are few examples, but Permanence from Wild Arms 3 is one.
texts.補助効果と別の補助効果。あるいは、攻撃や回復などの効果を併せて持たせることで別の: It is also possible to create another support technique by combining one support effect with another, or by adding effects such as damage or healing.
texts.「ダメージを２倍にする」という能力上昇型の補助効果と「敵の物理攻撃を一度だけ無効: A combination of the ability-enhancing support effect “doubles damage” and the defensive support effect “nullifies one of the enemy's physical attacks.”
texts.「そのターンの間、味方全体に対して、ダメージを半減する」という防御型の補助効果と: A combination of the defensive support effect “halves damage dealt to all allies for that turn” and the offensive effect “deals damage to enemies at the end of the turn.”
texts.当記事で、ＲＰＧで使用される主な補助技をまとめることができたと思う。もちろん、こ: I believe this article has covered the main support techniques used in RPGs. Of course, if you have ideas for other support techniques, I encourage you to try creating them.
texts.今回は味方側の視点を中心に解説したが、敵側について考えてみるのも面白い。味方が使: This time, I mainly explained things from the allies' perspective, but it can also be interesting to consider the enemy's side. A support technique that would definitely break the balance if allies could use it may not be nearly as problematic when it is exclusive to enemies. In that sense, enemies can be said to have greater freedom when it comes to support techniques.
texts.補助技はゲームシステムとも密接に関連する。例えば、ＳＲＰＧにおける移動力アップの: Support techniques are also closely connected to the game system. One example is a support technique that increases movement range in an SRPG. If you come up with your own unique system, try thinking of support techniques related to it as well.
